name: spend_total_7d
description: Total spend from purchases in the 7 days before observation_date
computation: SUM(transaction_amount) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-7 AND obs_date

name: spend_total_30d
description: Total spend from purchases in the 30 days before observation_date
computation: SUM(transaction_amount) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: spend_total_90d
description: Total spend from purchases in the 90 days before observation_date
computation: SUM(transaction_amount) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-90 AND obs_date

name: spend_total_180d
description: Total spend from purchases in the 180 days before observation_date
computation: SUM(transaction_amount) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-180 AND obs_date

name: avg_order_value_30d
description: Average transaction value per purchase in the last 30 days
computation: spend_total_30d / purchase_count_30d (0 if count is 0)

name: spend_per_purchase_90d
description: Average transaction value per purchase in the last 90 days
computation: spend_total_90d / purchase_count_90d (0 if count is 0)

name: purchase_count_7d
description: Number of purchase transactions in the 7 days before observation_date
computation: COUNT(transaction_id) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-7 AND obs_date

name: purchase_count_30d
description: Number of purchase transactions in the 30 days before observation_date
computation: COUNT(transaction_id) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: purchase_count_90d
description: Number of purchase transactions in the 90 days before observation_date
computation: COUNT(transaction_id) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-90 AND obs_date

name: purchase_count_180d
description: Number of purchase transactions in the 180 days before observation_date
computation: COUNT(transaction_id) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-180 AND obs_date

name: return_count_30d
description: Number of returned transactions in the 30 days before observation_date
computation: COUNT(transaction_id) WHERE transaction_type='return' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: return_count_90d
description: Number of returned transactions in the 90 days before observation_date
computation: COUNT(transaction_id) WHERE transaction_type='return' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-90 AND obs_date

name: recency_days
description: Number of days since the member's most recent purchase, relative to observation_date. Null for members who have never purchased.
computation: (obs_date - MAX(transaction_date)) WHERE transaction_type='purchase'

name: points_earned_lifetime
description: Cumulative points earned from all purchases up to observation_date, reconstructed from transaction-level sums. Excludes post-obs_date transactions.
computation: SUM(points_earned) WHERE transaction_date <= obs_date

name: points_redeemed_lifetime
description: Cumulative points redeemed (clawed back) up to observation_date, reconstructed from transaction-level sums.
computation: SUM(points_clawed_back) WHERE transaction_date <= obs_date

name: redemption_rate
description: Ratio of points redeemed to points earned, clipped to [0,1]. High values indicate members who actively burn their rewards.
computation: points_redeemed_lifetime / (points_earned_lifetime + 1e-6), clipped to [0,1]

name: hoarding_ratio
description: Ratio of current reconstructed point balance to lifetime points earned. High values indicate members sitting on large unspent balances.
computation: (points_earned_lifetime - points_redeemed_lifetime) / (points_earned_lifetime + 1e-6), clipped to [0,10]

name: email_open_30d
description: Raw count of email open events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='email_open' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: email_click_30d
description: Raw count of email click events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='email_click' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: email_click_rate_30d
description: Ratio of email clicks to email opens in the last 30 days. Clipped to [0,1]. 0 if no opens.
computation: email_click_30d / (email_open_30d + 1e-6), clipped to [0,1]

name: app_open_30d
description: Count of mobile app open events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='app_open' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: app_open_90d
description: Count of mobile app open events in the 90 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='app_open' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-90 AND obs_date

name: push_open_30d
description: Count of push notification open events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='push_open' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: reward_browse_30d
description: Count of reward catalog browse events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='reward_browse' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: reward_redemption_30d
description: Count of reward redemption events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='reward_redemption' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: tier_status_check_30d
description: Count of tier status check events in the 30 days before observation_date. High values indicate tier-motivated members.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='tier_status_check' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: support_contact_30d
description: Count of support contact events in the 30 days before observation_date. High values may indicate friction or dissatisfaction.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='support_contact' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: total_session_sec_30d
description: Total accumulated app or web session duration in seconds in the 30 days before observation_date. Sessions capped at 14,400s to remove outliers.
computation: SUM(LEAST(session_duration_sec, 14400)) WHERE event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: browse_to_purchase_ratio_30d
description: Ratio of reward catalog browse sessions to purchases in the last 30 days. High values indicate browsing without buying.
computation: reward_browse_30d / (purchase_count_30d + 1e-6), clipped to [0,10]

name: browsed_but_never_purchased_30d
description: Binary flag: 1 if member had reward browse sessions but zero purchases in the last 30 days.
computation: 1 if reward_browse_30d > 0 AND purchase_count_30d == 0, else 0

name: spend_slope_30d
description: OLS linear trend slope of weekly purchase spend over the 30 days before observation_date. Positive = growing, negative = declining. 0 if fewer than 2 weekly data points.
computation: OLS slope of 4 weekly spend buckets using closed-form: (N*sum(xy) - sum(x)*sum(y)) / (N*sum(x^2) - sum(x)^2)

name: frequency_slope_30d
description: OLS linear trend slope of weekly purchase count over the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: OLS slope of 4 weekly purchase count buckets, same formula as spend_slope_30d

name: spend_acceleration
description: Month-over-month change in spend_slope_30d. Captures whether spending momentum is accelerating or decelerating. 0 for first available month.
computation: spend_slope_30d(t) - spend_slope_30d(t-1 month)

name: category_diversity_90d
description: Ratio of unique merchant categories to total purchases in the last 90 days. 1.0 = every purchase from a different category.
computation: COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_category) / COUNT(transaction_id) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-90 AND obs_date, clipped to [0,1]

name: channel_diversity_90d
description: Ratio of unique purchase channels to total purchases in the last 90 days. Captures omnichannel breadth.
computation: COUNT(DISTINCT channel) / COUNT(transaction_id), clipped to [0,1]

name: unique_categories_90d
description: Absolute count of unique merchant categories purchased from in the 90 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_category) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-90 AND obs_date

name: unique_channels_90d
description: Absolute count of unique purchase channels used in the 90 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(DISTINCT channel) WHERE transaction_type='purchase' AND transaction_date BETWEEN obs_date-90 AND obs_date

name: tier_ordinal
description: Current tier encoded as an ordinal integer: base=0, silver=1, gold=2, platinum=3. Reconstructed as-of observation_date from tier_history JSON.
computation: Parse tier_history JSON, find most recent tier with date <= obs_date, encode as 0/1/2/3

name: tier_changes_count
description: Total number of tier changes (upgrades or downgrades) in the member's lifetime up to observation_date.
computation: COUNT(tier_history entries) WHERE date <= obs_date, minus 1 for initial enrollment tier

name: months_since_last_tier_change
description: Number of months between the most recent tier change and observation_date. Null for members who have never changed tier.
computation: DATEDIFF(months, MAX(tier_history.date WHERE date <= obs_date), obs_date)

name: spend_velocity
description: Ratio of 30-day spend to average monthly spend over the preceding 90 days. Values below 1.0 indicate slowing momentum relative to recent history.
computation: spend_total_30d / (spend_total_90d / 3 + 1e-6)

name: freq_velocity
description: Ratio of 30-day purchase frequency to average monthly frequency over the preceding 90 days.
computation: purchase_count_30d / (purchase_count_90d / 3 + 1e-6)

name: app_velocity
description: Ratio of 30-day app opens to average monthly app opens over the preceding 90 days.
computation: app_open_30d / (app_open_90d / 3 + 1e-6)

name: recency_risk
description: Composite recency risk score: days since last purchase multiplied by a low-frequency penalty. Higher = higher lapse risk.
computation: recency_days * clip(1 - purchase_count_30d/10, 0, 1)

name: engagement_score
description: Total digital engagement touchpoints in the last 30 days: sum of app opens, email opens, and push opens.
computation: app_open_30d + email_open_30d + push_open_30d

name: spend_decline_flag
description: Binary indicator: 1 if spend_velocity < 0.5, meaning recent spend is less than half the 3-month average.
computation: 1 if spend_velocity < 0.5 else 0

name: social_share_30d
description: Count of social share events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='social_share' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: referral_sent_30d
description: Count of referral sent events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='referral_sent' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: survey_completed_30d
description: Count of survey completed events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='survey_completed' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: point_balance_check_30d
description: Count of point balance check events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='point_balance_check' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date

name: profile_update_30d
description: Count of profile update events in the 30 days before observation_date.
computation: COUNT(event_id) WHERE event_type='profile_update' AND event_date BETWEEN obs_date-30 AND obs_date
